about: T1 web comparison arm readings, written by the loop (research/faceless-youtube/PREREG-DECISIONS.md §3.6). Nothing is deployed yet (28.9.2026): every field is empty. N = $pageview events whose $current_url equals canonicalUrl exactly and whose payload is exactly {$process_person_profile: false, $current_url} (§3.1, §3.4(c)); null means not read, never zero. D0 is the day BOTH d0 conditions hold (§3.5). At D0+56 the loop records read = {day, engagedStrangerViews, readAt, verdict} with verdict = evaluateWebArm (src/revenue/experiments.ts); src/__tests__/revenue/web-arm-readings.test.ts re-runs it.
